unit.title: Number Systems, Factors & Estimation
unit.essential_question: How does number structure help us calculate efficiently, recognize patterns, and judge whether results make sense?
big_ideas: Number sets are nested and connected.
Factors and prime structure describe how whole numbers are built.
Shared factors and multiples solve grouping and synchronization problems.
The order of operations preserves shared mathematical meaning.
Estimation is a reasoning tool, not merely rough arithmetic.

lessons.title: Number Families & the Real Number System
objectives: Classify natural, whole, integer, rational, irrational, and real numbers.
Explain how the major real-number sets are nested inside one another.
Represent, compare, and order rational and irrational values on a number line.
Identify the most specific number set that contains a value.
Justify a classification using fractions, decimal behavior, or perfect-square reasoning.

lessons.title: Factors, Multiples & Number Structure
objectives: List factor pairs of a whole number.
Generate multiples and identify common multiples.
Distinguish factors from multiples.
Use arrays and area models to represent factor relationships.

lessons.title: Prime Numbers, Divisibility & Factorization
objectives: Distinguish prime and composite numbers.
Apply divisibility rules for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, and 10.
Write prime factorizations using factor trees or repeated division.
Use exponents to express repeated prime factors.

lessons.title: Greatest Common Factor & Least Common Multiple
objectives: Find the greatest common factor using lists or prime factorization.
Find the least common multiple using lists or prime factorization.
Interpret GCF and LCM in context.
Explain why a chosen method is efficient.

lessons.title: Order of Operations & Numerical Expressions
objectives: Evaluate numerical expressions using the conventional order.
Treat multiplication and division as equal-priority operations performed left to right.
Treat addition and subtraction as equal-priority operations performed left to right.
Use grouping symbols and exponents accurately.
Identify and correct common errors.

lessons.title: Estimation, Compatible Numbers & Reasonableness
objectives: Estimate sums, differences, products, and quotients.
Choose an appropriate estimation strategy.
Use compatible numbers for mental calculation.
Evaluate whether an exact result is reasonable.
Communicate appropriate precision.

practice.title: Foundation Practice
practice.description: Scaffolded review with hints and smaller steps.
